text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, really~ Resting is my specialty.
So on that note, I'm gonna go sleep~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a fire?!
No, wait, it's not hot—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, the time has come!
It's the 'Ingredient Scramble! Okonomiyaki Bet Battle!'~!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
A sudden-death showdown with no turning back! Predict the roll of a 20-sided die!
Guess right and seize your opponent's bet ingredients!
Guess wrong and forfeit your own in a high-stakes gamble!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Oh, right. I was hungry and came to eat okonomiyaki... and then ended up being brought here... I think?)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Match 1 is this card!
"Miracle" VS "Gambler"!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm putting all my 'pork ball' tokens...
all-in on '17', of course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, having it all confiscated sucks,
but I'm just so starving right now...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Uhh... I'm betting all my green onions on number 13!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(If they confiscate everything, I can just leave midway...
and go eat at another okonomiyaki place!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, fair and square—
Roll the dice!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle makes a brilliant hit with "13"!
On top of the "Green Onion Ball" she already has,
she snatches Nakayama's "Pork Ball" as well~~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, did I actually win...?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“The winner stays on!
Your next opponent is—that ‘End of the Century Overlord’!”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Looks like Nakayama-san was scattered off into "plain noodles without toppings"...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—However, I will not let you surpass the Overlord of the End of the Century!
Shrimp! Octopus! Scallops!!
I shall shoulder all of your destinies myself!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Bwahaha!!
All BETs on the one and only Number '1'!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Th-Then—this time, ALL-IN on "3"!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, fair and square—
Roll the dice!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Whaaat!?
Hishi Miracle nails "3" once again!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"On top of the 'Green Onion' and 'Pork' okonomiyaki,
she's even seized the Overlord's 'Seafood' okonomiyaki, toooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... No way...
I won again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be that I actually get to eat the unprecedented
'Super Ultra Hyper DX Miracle Loaded
Super Jewel' dish...?!"
—Man, that name is way too long!!!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!! Entering the fray at the perfect moment!!
The final assassin to stop this unprecedented "Miracle"!
Naniwa's White Lightning—Tamamo Cross!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not just takoyaki.
I love okonomiyaki too..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's why, Hishi Miracle... all those ingredients
you earned—I'm takin' every last one!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —The roll's gonna be a '2'!! I'm goin' ALL-IN to multiply my payout!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I love okonomiyaki too!
It's a meal full of memories, something I'd eat with my family on the way home from watching sports—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My favorite joint!
Named after "Juube," so it's gotta be number "10"...
Since I've come this far, of course—I'm BETTING it all!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, fair and square...
—The final roll of the dice!!"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Number 10! It's 10, it's 10, it's 10~!
The 'Miracle Girl' Hishi Miracle!!
A 'Miraculous' Grand Slam achieved!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! The "Super Ultra Hyper DX Miracle All-Toppings Deluxe Tama-yaki" is so gooood!!
I'm so glad I was hungry for this~~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn* I slept so well.
That was a really weird dream, though~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Super Ultra Hyper DX Miracle
Loaded Super Cabbage Ball," huh...
I gotta try making that sometime~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Hishi Miracle returned afterward,
she had completely gotten her groove back!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, fair and square...
—The final roll of the dice!!"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Number 2! It's number 2, number 2, number 2—!
The 'Lightning of Naniwa,' Tamamo Cross!!
A colossal upset victoryーーーーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! All this way just to get "plain with no toppings"~!?
No waaaay~~~~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh, what a terrible dream...
Man~ and here I was having a nice nap, this sucks~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Miracle returned from the infirmary looking somewhat gaunt.
